rules.description: Strictly enforce historical deletion average threshold of 0.1%
Ensure zero MCF lint errors in generated output
Verify MaxDate is within allowable 3-year publication lag for common causes of death

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MaxDate, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_svs FROM stats WHERE StatVar NOT IN ('Count_MortalityEvent_ChronicGlomerulonephritisNephritisAndNephritisNotSpecifiedAsAcuteOrChronicAndRenalSclerosisUnspecified', 'Count_MortalityEvent_AccidentalDischargeOfFirearms', 'Count_MortalityEvent_DischargeOfFirearmsUndeterminedIntent', 'Count_MortalityEvent_PneumoconiosesAndChemicalEffects', 'Count_MortalityEvent_DiseasesOfAppendix', 'Count_MortalityEvent_BronchitisChronicAndUnspecified', 'Count_MortalityEvent_AcuteAndRapidlyProgressiveNephriticAndNephroticSyndrome', 'Count_MortalityEvent_Meningitis', 'Count_MortalityEvent_OtherNutritionalDeficiencies', 'Count_MortalityEvent_RespiratoryTuberculosis', 'Count_MortalityEvent_HyperplasiaOfProstate')
params.condition: CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) >= (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 3) AND total_svs >= 107

rules.description: Verify MaxDate is at least the last known year (2023 or 2024) for rare causes of death that may not appear in every future year due to CDC suppression

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MaxDate FROM stats WHERE StatVar IN ('Count_MortalityEvent_ChronicGlomerulonephritisNephritisAndNephritisNotSpecifiedAsAcuteOrChronicAndRenalSclerosisUnspecified', 'Count_MortalityEvent_AccidentalDischargeOfFirearms', 'Count_MortalityEvent_DischargeOfFirearmsUndeterminedIntent', 'Count_MortalityEvent_PneumoconiosesAndChemicalEffects', 'Count_MortalityEvent_DiseasesOfAppendix', 'Count_MortalityEvent_BronchitisChronicAndUnspecified', 'Count_MortalityEvent_AcuteAndRapidlyProgressiveNephriticAndNephroticSyndrome', 'Count_MortalityEvent_Meningitis', 'Count_MortalityEvent_OtherNutritionalDeficiencies', 'Count_MortalityEvent_RespiratoryTuberculosis', 'Count_MortalityEvent_HyperplasiaOfProstate')
params.condition: CASE WHEN StatVar IN ('Count_MortalityEvent_ChronicGlomerulonephritisNephritisAndNephritisNotSpecifiedAsAcuteOrChronicAndRenalSclerosisUnspecified', 'Count_MortalityEvent_AccidentalDischargeOfFirearms') THEN CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) >= 2023 ELSE CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) >= 2024 END
